hero.title: Encrypted custody designed for cross-border capital.
hero.subtitle: Create encrypted vaults, move across EVM networks, and operate under policy-controlled custody without noisy onboarding.

vaultIntel.label: Vault Intelligence
vaultIntel.title: Stay synced with live wallet context.
vaultIntel.body: This panel surfaces RainbowKit + wagmi state so you can verify active connections, swap accounts, and track EVM balances without leaving the landing page.
vaultIntel.statusDetail: WalletConnect, injected, and custom flows remain available.

createWallet.title: Spin up a fresh vault
createWallet.body: Generate a wallet, store an encrypted session copy, and sync to the custody vault.
createWallet.passwordPlaceholder: Create a passphrase you will remember
createWallet.emptyBody: Use a memorable phrase. It encrypts your local session copy.
createWallet.readyBody: Keep this tab open; your session copy stays local.
createWallet.buyWithCardDisabled: Using a default card provider. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_ONRAMP_URL_TEMPLATE to use your own checkout URL.
createWallet.receiveCryptoBody: Send ETH, USDC, EURC, or other supported EVM assets to this address.
createWallet.offlineReceiveNote: Funds can arrive while this app is offline. Sync balance after reconnect.

featureShowcase.title: Geometry-forward surfaces, calm by design
featureShowcase.body: Layered surfaces for wallet flows and onchain context, with clear hierarchy and low noise.

rituals.createDetail: Password-gated creation with clear UI feedback.
rituals.trackDetail: Instant UI sync when wallet state changes.

cards.metadataBody:

cards.contextBody:

region.title: Set your operating region.
region.body: Pick a region to tailor disclosure copy and privacy defaults. This is a UI preference only.
region.label: Region
region.disclaimer: Informational only. Not a certification claim.
region.signupBody: Get launch updates and security briefings.

connectWallet.title: Link your EVM wallet
connectWallet.body: Use your browser wallet to authenticate instantly.
connectWallet.emptyBody: Open the connector and approve access to sync balances.
connectWallet.noConnectorNote: No wallet connector detected. Install a browser wallet or set NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID for WalletConnect.
